hook: A single-crystal TiO2 gate insulator lets 2D transistors switch near the thermal limit with tiny standby power
hook_turn: lets 2D transistors switch near the thermal limit with tiny standby power
summary: A wafer-scale anatase titanium dioxide dielectric was transferred onto 2D semiconductors with a clean interface. Both n- and p-type transistors showed near-ideal subthreshold swing and very low hysteresis, and inverters drew subpicowatt static power. Demonstrated on individual devices and simple inverters, not large circuits.
title: Low-power 2D CFETs using single-crystal high-κ dielectrics.
